about: The thirty-three ancient demons below the three Primordials, Noir, Red and Blanc (order 96, D-193; order 97, D-197): hand-written, each a full profile and each one of a kind, all horned (their looks are rolled from their ids, A.POWER.demonLook). kind: its rank in Hell's peerage, the bestiary's ancient ranks (Marquis of Hell x20, Duke of Hell x9: six Pit-Mothers and three Ledger-Keepers, Prince of Hell x4: the Pit Dragons; data/bestiary.json world counts), ten levels below the old kinds; its office in Hell is its style; liege: the Primordial it is sworn to (ids kept: ghazrul is Red 12, morvane is Noir 11, vethrael is Blanc 10; their disputes are its grudges); home: a place of Hell by name (the Cinderlands, the Gatelands, the Hush, the disputed Scorched March, and the Ashen Marches, Hell's northern shore), every one of Hell (order 97: every demon lives there). Validated by tools/lint-figures.mjs.

category.name: The Ancient Demons
category.note: Thirty-three ancient demons stand below the three Primordials, each sworn to one of them and each one of a kind: twenty Marquises of Hell, nine Dukes (six Pit-Mothers and three Ledger-Keepers) and four Princes (the Pit Dragons). They rival the elder dragons.

figures.name: Skarn

skills.does: The air about it shakes with heat; blades and arrows slide off the shimmer.
Every lesser demon of his court fights as if she were watching.

items.does: A crown fired in the Kiln itself; it is never cool to the touch.

goals.why: to break the Glass Seal and bring his mistress up into the light
to sit at her right hand when she rules the south again

grudges.why: the old man bound his mistress under the sand
Noir walked away free and left her behind the seal

story: The first of the Marquises of Hell, and the oldest of Red's servants. He keeps her court at the Kiln, and her gate under the Burning Waste is still sealed.
The other Marquises bow to him in her name, and the lower demons of the Cinderlands come when he calls.
He has sent three hosts of lesser demons against the Glass Seal in eighty years. Each burned itself out against the glass. He means to send a fourth.

figures.name: Vesh

skills.does: A word spoken in fire: those who hear it choke on the air.

items.does: Yellow smoke hangs about it like a cloak of its own.

goals.why: to take the Kiln from Skarn and be first of the court

grudges.why: Skarn was named first, and Vesh is the cleverer

story: A Marquis of Hell who holds the yellow hills of Brimstone for Red.
Vesh has sent letters across the Scorched March to Noir's counting house. If the seal never breaks, Vesh means to have a new mistress.

figures.name: Mag

skills.does: She climbs on a stair of flame that burns whoever stands on the next step.

items.does: A black spear notched once for every gate-captain she has killed.

goals.why: to hold the Red Steps against Blanc's sworn demons, step by step

grudges.why: the Hush has crept up the Red Steps a stair a century

story: A Marquis of Hell who holds the Red Steps, the burnt stair of hills where the Cinderlands meet the Hush.
She has lost two of the high steps to the Hush already and told no one; Skarn believes the stair is whole.

figures.name: Harrak

skills.does: He walks, and the ground he walks over burns behind him for a long way.

items.does: Shod in iron from a gate he tore down.

goals.why: to hold the whole Scorched March for the Cinderlands

grudges.why: Grael holds Bonefield for Noir, a day's burn from his camp
Dirge sings at Cinder Ford, and his lesser demons will not cross it

story: A Marquis of Hell who camps on the Burnt Reach, the disputed ground all three Primordials claim. He has fought Noir's and Blanc's servants there for three hundred years.
He is tired. He has offered a truce at Cinder Ford in secret, and wants it more than he wants the March.

figures.name: Ossa

skills.does: She knows every place in the Ashen Marches where Hell is thin.

items.does: Nine keys of black iron. None of them opens a door men have built.

goals.why: to send the lower demons over the Sundering, a few each year, and see what comes back

grudges.why: the wardens of the Sundering burn every lesser demon she sends across

story: A Marquis of Hell who watches the Ashen Marches, the burned northern shore of Hell that looks across the water to the world of men, where the lower demons gather whenever a gate opens.
The lords of the southern coast know her name. They light fires on the headlands when her lesser demons are seen on the far shore.
She has crossed herself, twice, in a man's shape, and stood in a market of Goldsand. No one knew her.

figures.name: Brann

skills.does: The air about it shakes with heat; blades and arrows slide off the shimmer.
What he grips turns to black glass, and breaks.

items.does: Cut from the same black glass as the seal over his mistress.

goals.why: to learn how the Saint's glass was made, and how to unmake it

grudges.why: his glass is better than Brann's

story: A Marquis of Hell who works the black glass of Black Glass, where the sand runs to glass in the heat.
He has made a seal of his own, smaller, and tried it on a Pit-Mother's child. It held a year.

figures.name: Ruk

skills.does: Fire that falls like snow on a host and does not go out.

items.does: He keeps the teeth of every captain he has eaten, strung on chains.

goals.why: souls, of any kind and any master, so long as they are his

grudges.why: Scathe the Pit Dragon hunts in Emberfall and takes the best of his souls

story: A Marquis of Hell who holds Emberfall, where it rains cinders.
Ruk sells souls to Noir's court through the Scorched March. Skarn would burn him for it.

figures.name: Old Smoke

skills.does: The air about it shakes with heat; blades and arrows slide off the shimmer.
She calls, and the minor and lesser demons of her pits come up out of the ground.

items.does: A hollow of a hundred pits, every one of them warm.

goals.why: to fill the Cinderlands with her brood again, as before the seal

grudges.why: the wardens of the Sundering burn her children

story: The eldest of the six Pit-Mothers, who keeps the brood-pits of Smokehollow. Most of the imps that ever crossed the Sundering came out of her pits.
Her pits have been cold for twenty years: fewer of her young come up each spring, and she does not know why.

figures.name: Grisel

skills.does: A cloud of her young, each no bigger than a crow, each with teeth.

items.does: The first egg she ever laid. She carries the shell.

goals.why: to raise a brood larger than Old Smoke's

grudges.why: Old Smoke is honoured, and Grisel is not

story: A Pit-Mother of the Cinder Flats, whose brood hunts across the burning sand.
She has been stealing Old Smoke's young out of the pits of Smokehollow, one by one.

figures.name: Quill

skills.does: The air about it shakes with heat; blades and arrows slide off the shimmer.
It knows every soul that ever burned for Red, and what was paid for it.

items.does: It writes in a fire that does not burn the page.

goals.why: that every debt owed to the Cinderlands be paid, to the last soul

grudges.why: Nil's ledger and Quill's disagree by three souls

story: One of the three Ledger-Keepers, who keeps the account of the Cinderlands in the black glass of Glasswaste.
Quill's books show that Red owes Noir a debt from the day the seventh gate opened. Quill has told no one, because no one has asked.

figures.name: Gorm
figures.looks: Horned: a dragon's shape of black glass and brimstone, with a ridge of horns from brow to tail and the scars of two dragons' teeth on its throat.

skills.does: Against a dragon it fights with the hunger of the two it has eaten.

items.does: It sleeps between them.

goals.why: a third dragon, and then an elder

grudges.why: the King of Dragons once threw it down the Kiln's throat
it hates dragons, as all its kind do

story: A Pit Dragon, a demon in a dragon's shape, that lairs in the mountains of Glasswaste. The old songs say one of the four has eaten two dragons. This is the one.
The two it ate were young, the songs never say. It has never faced a grown dragon, and it knows it.

figures.name: Scathe

skills.does: It drops on its prey from the clouds of ash with its wings folded.

items.does: Worn round one horn.

goals.why: the Broken Ground, all of it, for its pit

grudges.why: Ruk calls it a thief of souls

story: A Pit Dragon that hunts the Broken Ground of the Scorched March, in Red's name when it remembers to be.
It answers to no Marquis. Skarn has given up sending for it.

figures.style: Pit Dragon of the Broken Ground
figures.looks: Horned: a dragon's shape gone wrong, long and wingless, its horns grown through its own jaw, its scales the colour of old burns.

figures.name: Silk

skills.does: Those who bargain with her feel that every word she says is reasonable.

items.does: They weigh a soul against a coin and are always right.

goals.why: a toll on every soul that passes the Seventh Gate
to keep her master's house while his shadow walks above

grudges.why: the Kiln-Lord calls her master a coward who left his sister bound

story: The first of Noir's Marquises, who keeps the Toll Road to the Counting House and takes a toll of every soul that passes.
She is said to be fair. She is.
She has not seen her master in eighty years. She keeps his house as if he might come back tomorrow, and fears he never will.

figures.name: Varo

skills.does: No one crosses a river he holds without paying something.

items.does: He drops coins in. They go somewhere.

goals.why: to hold every crossing of the Gatelands

grudges.why: Sallow undercuts his prices at Soulmarket

story: A Marquis of the Gatelands who holds the bridge-town of Tollbridge.
His tolls are short. He has been taking a tithe of Noir's own souls for a hundred years.

figures.name: Dross

skills.does: A debtor's chain of iron that tightens with every lie told.

items.does: Every link a soul that could not pay.

goals.why: to work off every debt in the mines of Ironsoul

grudges.why: Harrak burned his mines at the edge of the March

story: A Marquis of the Gatelands who keeps the mines of Ironsoul, where debts are worked off in iron.
There are men in his mines who still remember their names. He lets them, because they work harder.

figures.name: Sallow

skills.does: Every voice in the market turns to him when he speaks.

items.does: Ten of them, each with a soul set where the stone should be.

goals.why: to make Soulmarket the only market in Hell

grudges.why: Blanc drinks souls in the March and pays no toll

story: A Marquis of the Gatelands who keeps Soulmarket, where the souls of the damned are bought and sold.
Men who make bargains at the crossroads are said to be dealing with Sallow's agents.
He has bought the soul of a living king, on terms that come due at his death. Which king, only his book says.

figures.name: Grael

skills.does: He raises the dead of Bonefield into a wall that walks.

items.does: Sewn from the cloaks of Red's lesser demons.

goals.why: to hold Bonefield and the road through the March for the Gatelands

grudges.why: Harrak has burned his camp four times in a century

story: Noir's Marquis on the Scorched March, who holds Bonefield against Red's lesser demons and Blanc's sworn demons.
He has met Harrak at Cinder Ford, alone, and they did not fight. They talked of a truce.

figures.name: Ansel

skills.does: It stands in a shadow of its own, and the eye slides off it.
A tide of ash-water that drags men under.

items.does: It points to the nearest soul in debt.

goals.why: ships, to cross the Sundering by sea

grudges.why: the shipmasters of the Sundering will not sell him a keel

story: A Marquis of the Gatelands who keeps Pale Harbour on the Southern Ocean, the only harbour in Hell.
He has built one ship. It sank. He is building a second.

figures.name: Mott

skills.does: A spire of grey stone that falls where he points.

items.does: A shard of the first spire, worn at the throat.

goals.why: to be first in the Counting House when Silk falls

grudges.why: Silk holds the place he means to have

story: A Marquis of the Gatelands who holds the Grey Spires, a forest of stone towers above the Sundering.
He tells the other Marquises that Noir is dead. He is not sure it is a lie.

figures.name: Mother Mire

skills.does: She calls, and the minor and lesser demons of her pits come up out of the ground.

items.does: Her young are born owing.

goals.why: to keep her brood fed in the Debt Fields

grudges.why: Grisel's brood raids her fields

story: A Pit-Mother of the Debt Fields, whose young are put to work the day they crawl out of the pits.
She lets some of her young go over the Sundering unbound, owing nothing. Noir's Marquises would call it theft.

figures.name: Wenna

skills.does: Her young drop from above on threads, like spiders.

items.does: From the first gallows of Gallowsgate.

goals.why: a brood of her own, apart from the other mothers

grudges.why: Mother Mire is too soft with her young

story: A Pit-Mother of Gallowsgate, the gate-town of hangings at the edge of the Gatelands.
She has been feeding on Noir's debtors before they are written down. Nil has noticed.

figures.name: Nil

skills.does: It stands in a shadow of its own, and the eye slides off it.
Every bargain made through the gates since the first, and its terms, to the letter.

items.does: A book the size of a house. Even the Primordials are written in it.

goals.why: that every bargain be kept to its letter, by anyone, even a Primordial

grudges.why: Wenna eats debtors before they are written down

story: The eldest of the three Ledger-Keepers, who keeps the First Ledger in the Ledger, a town that is one great library.
It is said even the Primordials are in its books. It is said truly.
The First Ledger says Noir's debt from the Seventh Gate was never paid: the sorcerer-prince who opened it is owed something still. Nil is waiting for his heir to claim it.

figures.name: Rook

skills.does: It coils round a tower and crushes it with whoever is inside.

items.does: Promissory notes, thousands, that it cannot read.

goals.why: to guard the Counting House while Noir's shadow walks above

grudges.why: it hates dragons, as all its kind do

story: A Pit Dragon that nests among the Grey Spires and guards the road to the Counting House.
It is the only demon of the Gatelands that ever saw Noir without his shadow. It will not describe it.

figures.style: Pit Dragon of the Grey Spires
figures.looks: Horned: a grey dragon's shape coiled about a spire, with horns like a crown of iron spikes and eyes black from lid to lid.

figures.name: Lark

skills.does: A mist of thinned blood hangs about it; what is struck through it bleeds the striker.
A song like bells that makes a host forget why it came.

items.does: Seven bells of grey iron that ring with no one pulling them.

goals.why: that the tithe grow, cup by cup
to serve as Blanc wishes

grudges.why: Sallow sells blood that belongs to the tithe

story: The first of Blanc's Marquises, who keeps the bells of Bellmoor and the tithe when her mistress walks the roads of men.
Lark has tasted blood in the tithe that Blanc never drank: the Sword Saint's mother's. Lark does not know what it means.

figures.name: Dirge

skills.does: No lesser demon crosses the ford while he sings; most turn and go home.

items.does: It has never touched the bottom of the Ashwater.

goals.why: to hold Cinder Ford, the one crossing of the Ashwater, for the Hush

grudges.why: Harrak burns the reeds of the ford every summer

story: Blanc's Marquis on the Scorched March, who sings at Cinder Ford and holds the one crossing of the Ashwater.
He has heard Harrak and Grael talk of a truce at his ford. He has told Blanc, and Blanc said nothing.

figures.name: Velvet

skills.does: A mist of thinned blood hangs about it; what is struck through it bleeds the striker.
A pool of silence that drowns the sound of a man's own heart.

items.does: No one has seen her face under it.

goals.why: her own blood back, which Blanc drank from her long ago

grudges.why: she drank Velvet's blood for the tithe, long ago

story: A Marquis of the Hush who keeps the silent lake of Stillwater.
Her veins are dry. Blanc drank them, and Velvet serves to have the blood back.

figures.name: Cantor

skills.does: A whip of blood drawn from his own wrist, which breaks bone.

items.does: It beats time for the bleeding.

goals.why: that the tithe be pure

grudges.why: the elves have the oldest blood and will not give it

story: A Marquis of the Hush who keeps the blood-pools of the Long Quiet, a land where nothing makes a sound but the dripping.
He has kept an elf alive in a cage of silence for two hundred years, and bled him a cup a year. Blanc does not know.

figures.name: Wren

skills.does: A wind full of grey ash that blinds a company.

items.does: Taken from a boy who played it at a funeral Blanc came to.

goals.why: to see the world above, once

grudges.why: Mag holds the high Red Steps that look over Ashmeadow

story: The youngest of the Marquises, who keeps the grey meadows of Ashmeadow for the Hush.
Wren took the two high steps from Mag and told Blanc it was easy. It was not.

figures.name: Mute

skills.does: A mist of thinned blood hangs about it; what is struck through it bleeds the striker.
Where he stands, no spell is spoken and no horn is heard.

items.does: For bottles that hold blood.

goals.why: to keep the blood of the Silent Water still until it is needed

grudges.why: Silk takes a toll on every cup that passes the Toll Road

story: A Marquis of the Hush who keeps the Silent Water, where the tithe rests in black pools until Blanc calls for it.
He has never spoken. The other Marquises believe he cannot.

figures.name: Mother Grey

skills.does: A mist of thinned blood hangs about it; what is struck through it bleeds the striker.
She calls, and the minor and lesser demons of her pits come up out of the ground.

items.does: Pits of grey ash in the court of the Hush itself.

goals.why: that her brood be fed on the tithe, too, one day

grudges.why: Old Smoke calls her brood dumb

story: The eldest Pit-Mother of the Hush, whose pits are in the Grey Fields under Blanc's roofless cathedral.
Her youngest was born with white hair. She hides it from Blanc, who would want it.

figures.name: Lull

skills.does: A song that puts a sentry to sleep where he stands.

items.does: She rocks it. It is empty.

goals.why: children of men, to raise as her own

grudges.why: they took back the children she stole

story: A Pit-Mother of the Hollow Downs, of whom the border villages tell their children to be quiet at night.
Three children of men grew up in her pits. One of them is still alive, and grown.

figures.name: Vesper

skills.does: Every cup of the tithe, whose it was, and what was promised for it.

items.n: A lamp that never goes out
items.does: The last light of Lastlight.

goals.why: that every cup of the tithe was rightly taken

grudges.why: Cantor keeps blood he never wrote down

story: One of the three Ledger-Keepers, who writes down every cup of Blanc's tithe, at Lastlight.
Vesper's ledger shows blood owed to the tithe that was never taken: a king's, promised long ago.

figures.name: Knell

skills.does: A cry like a funeral bell; those who hear it feel their years.

items.does: Torn from a chapel of men and worn on its tail.

goals.why: to guard the graves of Graveside, where the Hush buries what Blanc has drained

grudges.why: Gorm boasts of dragons; Knell has eaten nothing so grand

story: A Pit Dragon that coils among the graves of Graveside in the Hush.
It sleeps on the grave of the sorcerer-prince who opened the Seventh Gate. It does not know whose grave it is.

figures.looks: Horned: a pale dragon's shape among the graves, its horns cracked like old bells, a chapel bell hung from its tail.
